question: Can the cross-encoder grade gate V8 (corrective RAG) on this corpus?
method: ai_ml dev jobs with gold evidence (25 jobs), top-10 hybrid candidates each, sigmoid(cross-encoder logit) of (job post, chunk)
finding: Grades do not separate relevant from irrelevant evidence (relevant median below other median). With min_evidence_score 0.35, V8 refused 96% of jobs (Recall@5 0.035, rag_variants.json). V8 is not shipped; the grade gate needs a domain-tuned grader.
